root_cause: A Buffer 429 during provider readback could leave local state without durable provider identity, allowing a later retry to cross the external create boundary again.
prevention_rule: Persist the Buffer provider post id immediately after create acknowledgement, store a bounded Retry-After cooldown, defer LinkedIn retries during cooldown, and never recreate a post when provider create is already acknowledged.

evidence.current_main_integration: Mira/Composio Instagram authority preserved; Buffer cooldown applies to Buffer-backed LinkedIn lanes
